title: Aline Griffith on Skorzeny taking over the WCC

tellings.quote: And then she says it was very different eight or nine years after that because Otto Skorzeny came in and took over the operation.

plain: According to the journals of Aline Griffith, an operation the story calls the WCC changed in the 1950s, when the former Nazi commando Otto Skorzeny "came in and took over the operation." The researcher Jason Simosa reads this from her journals. He says that by her account things were "very different eight or nine years after" the start. He does not spell out here what the WCC was.
